```{r load}
library(tidyverse)
df <- read_csv("../data/bc_full_factorial_dataset.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cond_stats <- df %>%
  group_by(condition_id) %>%
  summarise(mean_yield = mean(BC_yield_gL),
            pH = first(pH), Temp_C = first(Temp_C), RPM = first(RPM),
            Inoculum_pct = first(Inoculum_pct), Sugar_gL = first(Sugar_gL),
            .groups = "drop")

levels_list <- list(
  pH = c(4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0), Temp_C = c(25, 27.5, 30, 32.5, 35),
  RPM = c(50, 87.5, 125, 162.5, 200), Inoculum_pct = c(5, 7.5, 10, 12.5, 15),
  Sugar_gL = c(20, 30, 40, 50, 60)
)

get_neighbours <- function(cond_row) {
  neighbours <- list()
  for (f in names(levels_list)) {
    vals <- levels_list[[f]]
    idx <- which(vals == cond_row[[f]])
    for (delta in c(-1, 1)) {
      new_idx <- idx + delta
      if (new_idx >= 1 && new_idx <= length(vals)) {
        new_row <- cond_row; new_row[[f]] <- vals[new_idx]
        neighbours <- c(neighbours, list(new_row))
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(neighbours)
}

hill_climb <- function(start_id, max_steps = 100) {
  current <- cond_stats %>% filter(condition_id == start_id)
  for (step in 1:max_steps) {
    matched <- get_neighbours(current) %>%
      left_join(cond_stats %>% select(pH, Temp_C, RPM, Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL, ny = mean_yield),
                by = c("pH","Temp_C","RPM","Inoculum_pct","Sugar_gL"))
    best_n <- matched %>% filter(ny == max(ny, na.rm = TRUE))
    if (best_n$ny > current$mean_yield) {
      current <- cond_stats %>%
        filter(pH == best_n$pH, Temp_C == best_n$Temp_C, RPM == best_n$RPM,
               Inoculum_pct == best_n$Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL == best_n$Sugar_gL)
    } else break
  }
  current
}
```

## Exercise 1
```{r ex1}
set.seed(42)
starts <- sample(cond_stats$condition_id, 50)
global_best <- max(cond_stats$mean_yield)
n_reached <- sum(sapply(starts, function(s) hill_climb(s)$mean_yield >= global_best - 0.01))
cat(sprintf("Reached global optimum: %d / 50 restarts\n", n_reached))
```

## Exercise 2
```{r ex2, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
set.seed(7)
current <- cond_stats %>% slice_sample(n = 1)
path <- tibble(step = 0, yield = current$mean_yield)
for (s in 1:50) {
  matched <- get_neighbours(current) %>%
    left_join(cond_stats %>% select(pH, Temp_C, RPM, Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL, ny = mean_yield),
              by = c("pH","Temp_C","RPM","Inoculum_pct","Sugar_gL"))
  best_n <- matched %>% filter(ny == max(ny, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (best_n$ny > current$mean_yield) {
    current <- cond_stats %>% filter(pH == best_n$pH, Temp_C == best_n$Temp_C,
      RPM == best_n$RPM, Inoculum_pct == best_n$Inoculum_pct, Sugar_gL == best_n$Sugar_gL)
    path <- bind_rows(path, tibble(step = s, yield = current$mean_yield))
  } else { path <- bind_rows(path, tibble(step = s, yield = current$mean_yield)); break }
}
ggplot(path, aes(x = step, y = yield)) + geom_line(colour = "firebrick", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point() + labs(title = "Stuck at local optimum") + theme_minimal()
```
